name: Standard SOW clause library
comment: Governed, reusable clause snippets the author can drop into a SOW section (and AI drafting may reference). Each clause names the section it most often belongs to via section_hint so the editor can surface the relevant ones first. Edit the text here; re-run scripts/embed-definitions.mjs after any change.

clauses.title: Payment terms
clauses.text: Invoices are issued monthly in arrears against work delivered and are payable within 30 days of the invoice date. Time-and-materials work is billed at the agreed rates; prepaid blocks are drawn down before any time-and-materials charges apply. Late payments may accrue interest at the statutory rate. All figures are exclusive of applicable taxes.

clauses.title: Intellectual property
clauses.text: On full payment of the relevant fees, ownership of the bespoke deliverables created specifically for the customer under this engagement transfers to the customer. The supplier retains ownership of its pre-existing materials, tools, methods and frameworks, and grants the customer a non-exclusive, perpetual licence to use them to the extent they are embedded in the deliverables.

clauses.title: Change control
clauses.text: Any change to the agreed scope, deliverables, timeline or commercials is managed through a written change request. No change takes effect until both parties have agreed and signed it. Work outside the agreed scope is not undertaken until the corresponding change request is approved.

clauses.title: Warranties & liability
clauses.text: The supplier warrants that the services are performed with reasonable skill and care and in line with good industry practice. Except for liability that cannot be excluded by law, neither party is liable for indirect or consequential loss, and each party's total liability is capped at the fees paid under this engagement in the preceding twelve months.

clauses.title: Data handling & security
clauses.text: Each party complies with applicable data-protection law. The supplier processes customer data only as needed to deliver the services, applies appropriate technical and organisational security measures, and does not transfer data outside the agreed locations without prior written consent. Personal data is returned or securely destroyed at the end of the engagement on request.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: Each party keeps the other's confidential information secret, uses it only to perform this engagement, and discloses it only to personnel who need it and are bound by equivalent obligations. These obligations survive termination of the engagement.
